theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNext_eq
theorems.paperItem: A.2 coordinate update, coordinate-level equalities (tex 913-917)
theorems.informal: c_{i,t+1} = c_i - eta*(lam_i*c_i + zeta_i), i.e. the first form of the update equals the definition cNext. (The matrix-level step <x_{t+1},u_i> = ... is not in this file; it is MatrixBridge.IsEigenbasis.coord_sgdStep.)

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_eq_sum_div_sum
theorems.paperItem: eq. (10), first equality (tex 919-921)
theorems.informal: theta(cNext) = sum_D lam^2((1-eta lam)c - eta zeta)^2 / sum_all lam^2((1-eta lam)c - eta zeta)^2; no hypothesis (both sides are 0/0 = 0 at x_{t+1} = 0, the paper's convention theta(0) = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_eq_one_div
theorems.paperItem: eq. (10), second equality (tex 922)
theorems.informal: If s^D_{t+1} != 0 then theta_{t+1} = 1/(1 + s^B_{t+1}/s^D_{t+1}). The hypothesis is the paper's own (tex 928) and is necessary (OneStep.theta_eq_zero_and_one_div_eq_one). General state: OneStep.theta_eq_one_div.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.sD_cNext_eq_zero_iff
theorems.paperItem: Remark in A.2, exceptional set V = {s^D_{t+1} = 0} (tex 928-931)
theorems.informal: s^D_{t+1} = 0 iff eta*zeta_i = (1-eta lam_i) c_i for all i in D (any block and moment: Spec.mom_cNext_eq_zero_iff). The measure-zero claim is left to the probability layer.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.s_cNext_eq_zero_iff
theorems.paperItem: Remark in A.2, exceptional set {s_{t+1} = 0} (tex 928) [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: s_{t+1} = 0 iff eta*zeta_i = (1-eta lam_i) c_i for ALL i (a single point when eta != 0); Spec.s_cNext_pos_iff is the positive form.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_sub_theta
theorems.paperItem: A.2, identity behind tex 941-944 (not stated in the paper)
theorems.informal: theta_{t+1} - theta_t = fCompare/(s_t * s_{t+1}) when s_t != 0 and s_{t+1} != 0 (two arbitrary states: OneStep.theta_sub_theta).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_theta_cNext_iff
theorems.paperItem: A.2, theta_{t+1} > theta_t <-> f_t > 0 (tex 941-944) [signature changed in fix1: hs' dropped]
theorems.informal: If s_t > 0 (x_t != 0; nothing assumed on x_{t+1}): theta c < theta (cNext eta c zeta) <-> 0 < fCompare eta c zeta. The hypothesis x_t != 0 is missing in the paper and is needed.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_theta_cNext_iff_sharp
theorems.paperItem: A.2, exact validity of theta_{t+1} > theta_t <-> f_t > 0 [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: (theta_t < theta_{t+1} <-> 0 < f_t) holds IFF (s_t > 0 or s^D_{t+1} = 0). So under the paper's assumption s^D_{t+1} != 0 the paper's equivalence holds exactly when x_t != 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_lt_theta_iff
theorems.paperItem: A.2, theta_{t+1} < theta_t <-> f_t < 0 (tex 941-944) [signature changed in fix1: hs dropped]
theorems.informal: If s_{t+1} > 0 (the paper's own assumption, tex 928; nothing assumed on x_t): theta (cNext eta c zeta) < theta c <-> fCompare eta c zeta < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_lt_theta_iff_sharp
theorems.paperItem: A.2, exact validity of theta_{t+1} < theta_t <-> f_t < 0 [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: (theta_{t+1} < theta_t <-> f_t < 0) holds IFF (s_{t+1} > 0 or s^D_t = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_eq_theta_iff
theorems.paperItem: A.2, equality case (not in the paper; task item (a))
theorems.informal: If s_t > 0 and s_{t+1} > 0: theta_{t+1} = theta_t <-> fCompare = 0 (both hypotheses needed). Exact validity: Spec.theta_cNext_eq_theta_iff_sharp: holds IFF (s_t > 0 or s^D_{t+1} = 0) and (s_{t+1} > 0 or s^D_t = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_theta_cNext_of_fCompare_pos
theorems.paperItem: A.2 (tex 941-944), one direction
theorems.informal: fCompare > 0 implies theta_{t+1} > theta_t with no positivity hypothesis (companion: Spec.theta_cNext_lt_theta_of_fCompare_neg).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_theta_lt_theta_cNext_and_fCompare_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: A.2, theta_{t+1} > theta_t <-> f_t > 0 as literally stated (no hypothesis on x_t)
theorems.informal: For every spectrum there are eta, c (= 0), zeta with theta_{t+1} > theta_t but f_t = 0: the equivalence fails at x_t = 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_theta_cNext_lt_theta_and_fCompare_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: A.2: necessity of the paper's assumption s_{t+1} != 0 for the '<' equivalence (not an error of the paper)
theorems.informal: For every spectrum there are eta (= 1/lam_1), c (= u_1), zeta (= 0) with theta_{t+1} < theta_t but f_t = 0 (x_{t+1} = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.lam_sq_mul_cNext_sq
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Elementwise expectation', proof expansion (tex 1076-1081)
theorems.informal: lam_i^2 c_{i,t+1}^2 = lam_i^2(1-eta lam_i)^2 c_i^2 - 2 eta lam_i^2 (1-eta lam_i) c_i zeta_i + eta^2 lam_i^2 zeta_i^2 (pathwise).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_singleton
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Elementwise expectation', per-coordinate identity (tex 1062-1066)
theorems.informal: EsNext N {i} eta c = (1-eta lam_i)^2 lam_i^2 c_i^2 + eta^2 lam_i^2 kap2_i; EsNext of a block is the sum of these (Spec.EsNext_eq_sum_singleton); regrouping in powers of eta: Spec.EsNext_term_eq.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_eq
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Elementwise expectation', block form (tex 1090-1093)
theorems.informal: For every block S: EsNext N S eta c = mom S 2 c - 2 eta mom S 3 c + eta^2 (mom S 4 c + sum_{i in S} lam_i^2 kap2_i).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_D
theorems.paperItem: eq. (Eat) (tex 1069)
theorems.informal: EsNext N D eta c = sD c - 2 eta tauD c + eta^2 (mom D 4 c + eD N).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_B
theorems.paperItem: eq. (Ebt) (tex 1070)
theorems.informal: EsNext N B eta c = sB c - 2 eta tauB c + eta^2 (mom B 4 c + eB N).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.mom_two_cNext
theorems.paperItem: decomposition s^S_{t+1} = chi + g^T z + z^T D z (tex 1011-1021)
theorems.informal: mom S 2 (cNext) = sum_S lam^2(1-eta lam)^2 c^2 - 2 eta sum_S lam^2(1-eta lam) c zeta + eta^2 sum_S lam^2 zeta^2.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.mom_two_cNext_sub_EsNext
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Elementwise expectation' (centred pathwise form, not in the paper)
theorems.informal: s^S_{t+1} - EsNext = -2 eta sum_S lam^2(1-eta lam) c zeta + eta^2 sum_S lam^2 (zeta^2 - kap2): the bridge for the probability layer.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expect_mom_two_cNext
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Elementwise expectation' (abstract expectation)
theorems.informal: For any linear functional E on ALL functions Omega -> R with E 1 = 1, E zeta_i = 0, E zeta_i^2 = kap2_i: E[mom S 2 (cNext eta c (zeta .))] = EsNext N S eta c. (Covers finite averages, not the Bochner integral; the integral version is in Prob/NoiseModel.lean.)

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_nonneg
theorems.paperItem: task item (e): positivity of E[s^S_{t+1}|x_t]
theorems.informal: 0 <= EsNext N S eta c for every block; also Spec.EsNext_zero: EsNext at eta = 0 equals mom S 2 c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_eq_zero_iff
theorems.paperItem: task item (e): positivity of E[s^S_{t+1}|x_t]
theorems.informal: EsNext N S eta c = 0 iff for all i in S: (1-eta lam_i) c_i = 0 and eta*kap2_i = 0; Spec.EsNext_pos_iff is the positive form; sufficient conditions Spec.EsNext_pos_of_kap2_pos, Spec.EsNext_pos_of_smin_pos, Spec.EsNext_pos_of_state.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.EsNext_D_add_EsNext_B_pos_iff
theorems.paperItem: task item (e): positivity of E[s_{t+1}|x_t]
theorems.informal: EsNext D + EsNext B > 0 iff some i has (1-eta lam_i) c_i != 0 or eta*kap2_i != 0 (Spec.EsNext_D_add_EsNext_B: the sum is EsNext univ; Spec.EsNext_D_add_EsNext_B_pos_of_smin_pos: holds if eta != 0 and smin > 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Quadratic form', E[f_t(eta)|x_t] (first line of proof, tex 1113)
theorems.informal: def expF P N eta c := sB c * EsNext N D eta c - EsNext N B eta c * sD c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_eq
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Quadratic form', eq. (quad-form) (tex 1098-1102)
theorems.informal: expF N eta c = pCoef N c * eta^2 + qCoef c * eta (factored form Spec.expF_eq_mul; Spec.expF_zero: value 0 at eta = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expect_fCompare
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Quadratic form' (abstract expectation)
theorems.informal: For any normalised linear functional E on all functions Omega -> R with E zeta_i = 0, E zeta_i^2 = kap2_i: E[fCompare eta c (zeta .)] = expF N eta c (pathwise bridge: Spec.fCompare_sub_expF).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qCoef_le
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign), first inequality (tex 1105)
theorems.informal: qCoef c <= 2 * sB c * sD c * (lamk1 - lamk); uses OneStep.tauB_le and OneStep.le_tauD (tex 1123).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qCoef_nonpos
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign)
theorems.informal: qCoef c <= 0 for every state.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qCoef_neg
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign), strict inequality q_t < 0 (tex 1105, 1123)
theorems.informal: If sD c > 0 and sB c > 0 then qCoef c < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qCoef_neg_iff
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign), exact strictness condition
theorems.informal: qCoef c < 0 iff sD c > 0 and sB c > 0; Spec.qCoef_neg_iff_theta: iff 0 < theta c < 1; Spec.qCoef_eq_zero_iff / _iff_theta: qCoef c = 0 iff theta c in {0,1}.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_theta_eq_one_qCoef_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign), unconditional claim q_t < 0
theorems.informal: For every spectrum there is c != 0 with theta c = 1 and qCoef c = 0 (c = u_1).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_theta_eq_zero_qCoef_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: eq. (q-sign), unconditional claim q_t < 0
theorems.informal: For every spectrum there is c != 0 with theta c = 0 and qCoef c = 0 (c = u_{k+1}).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pCoef_of_sD_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: eq. (p-def), degenerate cases (not in the paper)
theorems.informal: If sD c = 0 then pCoef N c = sB c * eD N; Spec.pCoef_of_sB_eq_zero: if sB c = 0 then pCoef N c = -(sD c * eB N).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStar_eq
theorems.paperItem: main text eq. (2) (tex 388-395)
theorems.informal: etaStar N c = 2(sB tauD - sD tauB) / (sB (mom D 4 + eD) - sD (mom B 4 + eB)).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_eq_zero_iff
theorems.paperItem: Lemma 'Quadratic form': eta* is the non-zero root when p_t != 0 (tex 1108)
theorems.informal: For pCoef != 0: expF N eta c = 0 iff eta = 0 or eta = etaStar N c (Spec.expF_etaStar: etaStar is a root; Spec.etaStar_eq_zero_iff: etaStar = 0 iff qCoef = 0, so 'non-zero' needs 0 < theta < 1).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStar_pos
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t > 0: eta* > 0 (tex 1145)
theorems.informal: If pCoef > 0 and qCoef < 0 then etaStar > 0; Spec.etaStar_pos_iff: for pCoef > 0, etaStar > 0 iff sD > 0 and sB > 0; Spec.etaStar_nonneg: etaStar >= 0 when pCoef > 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStar_pos_iff_pCoef_pos_and_qCoef_neg
theorems.paperItem: Remark / Theorem 2: when is eta* > 0 (unconditional) [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: 0 < etaStar N c <-> 0 < pCoef N c and qCoef c < 0, with no hypothesis. Also Spec.etaStar_pos_iff_pCoef_pos_and_theta (<-> pCoef > 0 and 0 < theta < 1) and Spec.etaStar_nonpos_of_pCoef_nonpos (pCoef <= 0 gives etaStar <= 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_pCoef_pos_and_etaStar_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t > 0: 'since q_t < 0 there exists a positive critical step size'
theorems.informal: If eD N > 0 there is c != 0 with pCoef > 0, etaStar = 0 and expF > 0 for every eta != 0 (c = u_{k+1}, theta = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_neg_iff_lt_etaStar
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t > 0, small step (tex 1145)
theorems.informal: For pCoef > 0 and eta > 0: expF < 0 iff eta < etaStar.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_neg_of_lt_etaStar
theorems.paperItem: Remark, small step, with the hypotheses of Theorem 2 only [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: If 0 < eta < etaStar N c then expF N eta c < 0, with no assumption on pCoef (Spec.lt_etaStar_iff: for eta > 0, eta < etaStar <-> pCoef > 0 and expF < 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_eq_zero_iff_eq_etaStar
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t > 0, critical step
theorems.informal: For pCoef > 0 and eta > 0: expF = 0 iff eta = etaStar.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_pos_iff_etaStar_lt
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t > 0, large step (tex 1145)
theorems.informal: For pCoef > 0 and eta > 0: expF > 0 iff etaStar < eta.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_neg_of_pCoef_nonpos
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t <= 0 (paper: p_t < 0, tex 1147)
theorems.informal: If pCoef <= 0, qCoef < 0 and eta > 0 then expF < 0 (covers the paper's omitted case p_t = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_neg_of_pCoef_neg
theorems.paperItem: Remark, case p_t < 0 (tex 1147)
theorems.informal: If pCoef < 0 and eta > 0 then expF < 0 (only q_t <= 0 is used); Spec.expF_nonpos_of_pCoef_nonpos: pCoef <= 0, eta >= 0 gives expF <= 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.expF_pos_iff
theorems.paperItem: Remark (complete sign description, beyond the paper)
theorems.informal: For eta > 0: expF > 0 iff pCoef > 0 and etaStar < eta. Spec.expF_neg_iff: expF < 0 iff (pCoef > 0 and eta < etaStar) or (pCoef <= 0 and (pCoef < 0 or qCoef < 0)). Division-free: Spec.expF_neg_iff_linear / Spec.expF_pos_iff_linear (sign of pCoef*eta + qCoef).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_sub_theta
theorems.paperItem: bridge display (tex 1038-1048), deterministic equivalent
theorems.informal: If s c != 0 and EsNext D + EsNext B != 0: thetaBarNext N eta c - theta c = expF N eta c / (s c * (EsNext D + EsNext B)).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_iff
theorems.paperItem: bridge display (tex 1038-1048), decrease [signature changed in fix1: hs dropped]
theorems.informal: If EsNext D + EsNext B > 0 (nothing assumed on x_t): thetaBarNext N eta c < theta c <-> expF N eta c < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_thetaBarNext_iff
theorems.paperItem: bridge display, increase [signature changed in fix1: hE dropped]
theorems.informal: If s c > 0 (nothing assumed on E s_{t+1}): theta c < thetaBarNext N eta c <-> 0 < expF N eta c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_eq_theta_iff
theorems.paperItem: bridge display, equality
theorems.informal: If s c > 0 and EsNext D + EsNext B > 0: thetaBarNext = theta <-> expF = 0 (both hypotheses needed).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_iff_sharp
theorems.paperItem: bridge display: exact validity of the three equivalences [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: (thetaBarNext < theta <-> expF < 0) holds IFF (EsNext D + EsNext B > 0 or sD c = 0). Spec.theta_lt_thetaBarNext_iff_sharp: (theta < thetaBarNext <-> 0 < expF) holds IFF (s c > 0 or EsNext D = 0). Spec.thetaBarNext_eq_theta_iff_sharp: the '=' equivalence holds IFF both conditions hold.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_iff_of_smin_pos
theorems.paperItem: bridge display, decrease, under non-degenerate noise [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: If eta != 0 and smin > 0 then for EVERY state c (including 0): thetaBarNext N eta c < theta c <-> expF N eta c < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_of_expF_neg
theorems.paperItem: bridge display, direction used by the theorems
theorems.informal: expF < 0 implies thetaBarNext < theta with no positivity hypothesis; Spec.theta_lt_thetaBarNext_of_expF_pos: expF > 0 implies theta < thetaBarNext.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_zero_lt_thetaBarNext_and_expF_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: bridge display: necessity of x_t != 0 for the increase/equality equivalences
theorems.informal: At c = 0 with eta != 0 and eD N > 0: theta 0 < thetaBarNext N eta 0 although expF N eta 0 = 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.exists_thetaBarNext_lt_theta_and_expF_eq_zero
theorems.paperItem: bridge display: necessity of E[s_{t+1}] > 0 for the decrease/equality equivalences
theorems.informal: With zero noise there are eta, c with thetaBarNext < theta although expF = 0 (EsNext D + EsNext B = 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_eq_one_div
theorems.paperItem: eq. (ratio-asymp) form of the deterministic equivalent
theorems.informal: If EsNext D != 0: thetaBarNext = 1/(1 + EsNext B / EsNext D); also Spec.thetaBarNext_nonneg, Spec.thetaBarNext_le_one, Spec.thetaBarNext_zero (eta = 0 gives theta).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_of_lt_etaStar
theorems.paperItem: finite-d deterministic-equivalent core of Theorem 2 (decrease) [signature changed in fix1: hp dropped]
theorems.informal: If 0 < eta < etaStar N c (exactly the hypothesis of Theorem 2) then thetaBarNext N eta c < theta c. Statement about the ratio of expectations, not about E[theta_{t+1}].

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_thetaBarNext_of_etaStar_lt
theorems.paperItem: finite-d deterministic-equivalent core of the increase condition
theorems.informal: If pCoef > 0 and etaStar < eta then theta c < thetaBarNext N eta c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thetaBarNext_lt_theta_of_pCoef_nonpos
theorems.paperItem: finite-d deterministic-equivalent core of the case p_t <= 0
theorems.informal: If pCoef <= 0, sD > 0, sB > 0 and eta > 0 then thetaBarNext N eta c < theta c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.mom_add_le
theorems.paperItem: moment bounds (tex 1123 and analogues)
theorems.informal: If lam_i <= b on S then mom S (p+j) c <= b^j * mom S p c; OneStep.le_mom_add is the lower bound; specialisations OneStep.tauB_le, le_tauB, tauD_le, le_tauD, mom_four_B_le, le_mom_four_B, mom_four_D_le, le_mom_four_D.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.theta_mem_Ioo_iff
theorems.paperItem: helper facts on theta of an arbitrary state (not in the paper)
theorems.informal: 0 < theta c < 1 iff sD c > 0 and sB c > 0; also OneStep.theta_pos_iff, theta_eq_zero_iff, theta_eq_one_iff, theta_eq_zero_or_eq_one_iff, mom_eq_zero_iff, mom_pos_iff, theta_lt_theta_of_pos, theta_gt_theta_of_neg.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.theta_lt_theta_iff
theorems.paperItem: two-state comparison lemmas [signatures changed in fix1]
theorems.informal: For two arbitrary states: if s c > 0 then theta c < theta c' <-> 0 < sB c * sD c' - sB c' * sD c (hs' dropped); OneStep.theta_gt_theta_iff: if s c' > 0 then theta c' < theta c <-> cross < 0 (hs dropped); OneStep.theta_eq_theta_iff keeps both hypotheses.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.theta_lt_theta_iff_sharp
theorems.paperItem: two-state comparison lemmas: exact validity [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: (theta c < theta c' <-> 0 < cross) holds IFF (s c > 0 or sD c' = 0); OneStep.theta_gt_theta_iff_sharp: IFF (s c' > 0 or sD c = 0); OneStep.theta_eq_theta_iff_sharp: IFF both.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.ratio_lt_ratio_iff_sharp
theorems.paperItem: real-variable core of all comparison lemmas [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: For a,b,a',b' >= 0: (a/(a+b) < a'/(a'+b') <-> 0 < b a' - b' a) holds IFF (a+b > 0 or a' = 0). Also OneStep.ratio_gt_ratio_iff_sharp, OneStep.ratio_eq_ratio_iff_sharp, OneStep.ratio_sub_ratio.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.exSpec_expect_fCompare_pos_and_expect_theta_lt
theorems.paperItem: Remark (tex 1145), literal finite-d reading of 'E f > 0 implies E[theta_{t+1}] increases' [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: lam = (2,1), D = {0}, x_t = (1,1), kap^2 = (1,1), eta = 1 > eta* = 2/3, two-point noise zeta = +-(1,1) (mean 0, second moments 1): E f = 4 > 0 and theta_t = 4/5 < thetaBarNext = 8/9, but E[theta_{t+1}] = 8/17 < theta_t. Formal for this non-Gaussian noise; the Gaussian analogue is numerical only.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.OneStep.exSpec_expect_fCompare_neg_and_theta_lt_expect_theta
theorems.paperItem: Remark (tex 1145) / Theorem 2, literal finite-d reading of '0 < eta < eta* implies E[theta_{t+1}] decreases' [NEW in fix1]
theorems.informal: lam = (2,1), x_t = (1,1), kap^2 = (4,4), eta = 1/3 < eta* = 2/3, two-point noise zeta = +-(2,2): E f = -4/3 < 0 and thetaBarNext = 5/7 < theta_t = 4/5, but E[theta_{t+1}] = 11/13 > theta_t. Formal for this non-Gaussian noise; the Gaussian analogue is numerical only.

paperIssues: G1 (eq. (q-sign), tex 1105/1123): the claim q_t < 0 is not unconditional. q_t <= 2 s^B s^D (lam_{k+1} - lam_k) is correct, but strictness needs s^B s^D > 0. Exact statement proved: q_t <= 0 always, q_t < 0 iff 0 < theta_t < 1, q_t = 0 iff theta_t in {0,1} (including x_t = 0). Formal counterexamples for every spectrum: x_t = u_1 (theta = 1, q = 0) and x_t = u_{k+1} (theta = 0, q = 0): Spec.exists_theta_eq_one_qCoef_eq_zero, Spec.exists_theta_eq_zero_qCoef_eq_zero.

G2 (Remark, tex 1145, and 'the non-zero root', tex 1108): 'since q_t < 0 there exists a positive critical step size eta* > 0' fails at theta_t = 0: there p_t = s^B e_D > 0 (if e_D > 0), q_t = 0, eta* = 0 and E[f_t(eta)|x_t] = p_t eta^2 > 0 for every eta != 0 (Spec.exists_pCoef_pos_and_etaStar_eq_zero). Exact: eta* > 0 iff p_t > 0 and 0 < theta_t < 1 (Spec.etaStar_pos_iff_pCoef_pos_and_theta), so the hypothesis 0 < eta < eta* of Theorem 2 already forces p_t > 0 and 0 < theta_t < 1. The p_t < 0 half of the Remark is correct as it only needs q_t <= 0.

G3 (Remark, tex 1126-1147): the case p_t = 0 is omitted. Then E f = q_t eta, negative for eta > 0 iff q_t < 0, and identically 0 if also q_t = 0 (e.g. theta_t = 1 and e_B = 0). So 'the behaviour for eta > 0 is entirely determined by the sign of p_t' is slightly too strong; exact description in Spec.expF_neg_iff.

G4 (A.2, tex 941-944; corrected in fix1): only the '>' equivalence has a gap. theta_{t+1} > theta_t <-> f_t > 0 needs x_t != 0, which the paper does not assume (counterexample at x_t = 0: Spec.exists_theta_lt_theta_cNext_and_fCompare_eq_zero); exactly, it holds iff x_t != 0 or s^D_{t+1} = 0. theta_{t+1} < theta_t <-> f_t < 0 is correct as stated under the paper's own assumption s_{t+1} != 0 (tex 928), for every x_t; exactly, it holds iff x_{t+1} != 0 or s^D_t = 0. The '=' version and the identity theta_{t+1} - theta_t = f_t/(s_t s_{t+1}) need both. The directions f > 0 => increase and f < 0 => decrease hold unconditionally.

G4b (Remark in A.2, tex 928-934): the two exceptional sets differ. {s_{t+1} = 0} is a single point for eta != 0 (Spec.s_cNext_eq_zero_iff), hence null for any Gaussian with Sigma != 0 (true under Tr Sigma > 0). {s^D_{t+1} = 0} is the affine set V of dimension d-k (a hyperplane only if k = 1; no Sard needed); it is null for xi ~ N(0,Sigma) only if the D-marginal does not charge the point, which Tr Sigma > 0 does not ensure: if kap_i^2 = 0 and (1-eta lam_i)c_i = 0 for all i in D (e.g. bulk-only noise and theta_t = 0) then s^D_{t+1} = 0 surely. The correct hypothesis is exactly E[s^D_{t+1}|x_t] > 0 (Spec.EsNext_pos_iff), implied by eta != 0 and s_min > 0. Measure-zero statements are not formalized here (probability layer).

G5 (bridge display, tex 1040-1048): typo theta_t = 1/(1 - (1/rho)...) should have '+'; only the implication 'decrease => E f < 0' is stated while the theorems use the converse. At finite d: thetaBarNext - theta = expF/(s_t E[s_{t+1}]); the decrease equivalence needs only E[s_{t+1}] > 0 (true for every state if eta != 0 and s_min > 0), the increase equivalence needs only x_t != 0, the equality version needs both (exact conditions: the three ..._iff_sharp lemmas; witnesses Spec.theta_zero_lt_thetaBarNext_and_expF_eq_zero, Spec.exists_thetaBarNext_lt_theta_and_expF_eq_zero). The direction actually needed by the theorems is unconditional.

G6 (remark, no error): the two lemmas of A.5 use only E zeta_i = 0 and E zeta_i^2 = kap_i^2; neither Gaussianity nor diagonality of Sigma in the eigenbasis is needed, and they hold for every real eta, every state and every finite d.

G7 (Remark, tex 1145-1147; new in fix1): 'E[f_t] < 0, implying the expected alignment E[theta_{t+1}] decreases' (and the increase analogue) is false when read at finite d. The sign of E[f_t] decides the sign of thetaBarNext - theta_t (ratio of expectations) only; the passage to E[theta_{t+1}] is asymptotic (d -> infinity). Formal witnesses with a two-point noise having the prescribed first two moments, in both directions: OneStep.exSpec_expect_fCompare_pos_and_expect_theta_lt (E f = 4 > 0 but E theta_{t+1} = 8/17 < 4/5) and OneStep.exSpec_expect_fCompare_neg_and_theta_lt_expect_theta (0 < eta < eta*, E f = -4/3 < 0 but E theta_{t+1} = 11/13 > 4/5). Numerical (not formal) counterexamples with Gaussian noise, d = 2, lam = (2,1), 2e7 Monte Carlo samples, s.e. ~1e-4: x = (1,1), Sigma = I, eta = 1: E f = +4, thetaBarNext = 0.889 > theta_t = 0.8, E theta_{t+1} = 0.7588 < theta_t; x = (1,2), Sigma = diag(1/4, 9), eta = 5/4 < eta* = 2: E f = -15, thetaBarNext = 0.425 < theta_t = 0.5, E theta_{t+1} = 0.5540 > theta_t. The reviewer's instance (x = (-1.1593, 0.8333), kap^2 = (4.4638, 0.2543), eta = 0.6629) was reproduced (0.8661 +- 0.0002 < 0.8856).
G8 (typo, tex 934): 'The case of {xi | s^D_{t+1}(xi) = 0} is analogous' should read {xi | s_{t+1}(xi) = 0}; and by G4b the two cases are not analogous.
unproven: Nothing in the scope of this file (exact finite-d algebraic layer) is left unproven.

Not formalized in this file by design: the measure-zero and integrability claims of the A.2 Remark (tex 928-934) and the genuine conditional expectations (probability layer, SuspiciousAlignment/Prob/NoiseModel.lean); the matrix-level coordinate step of tex 915 (MatrixBridge.IsEigenbasis.coord_sgdStep in MatrixBridge.lean); every d -> infinity statement about E[theta_{t+1}].

The finite-d failure of 'E f < 0 implies E[theta_{t+1}] decreases' for GAUSSIAN noise (G7) is supported by Monte Carlo only; the two formal witnesses use a two-point noise with the same first two moments.
